title: Richard Bissell sets up Area 51 for U-2 testing
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Richard Bissell sets up Area 51 for U-2 testing, about 1955 at Nevada test site and Area 51, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Richard Bissell set it up as Area 51 to test uh the U2 spy plane in 1955,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1955 a man named Richard Bissell set up Area 51, a secret base in the Nevada desert, to test the U-2, an American spy plane. Michels tells it as the origin story of the place that later became central to UFO talk.
